correspondences.boundary: Collected old-space only; static objects excluded. Compact and eligible are abstract predicates, not measured density or a reconstruction of exact thresholds.
Actual selection uses must_mark and eligible segment/chunk compactness. space_new excludes segment use_marks; a locked object can still be marked separately.
Initialization precedes pointer publication in source through STORE_FENCE. SC model does not prove native instruction or compiler ordering.
Generated copy body precedes FWDADDRESS and FWDMARKER. Object-shape coverage and all generated configurations are still open.
Mixed space_new objects share one segment owner. Other profiles use two segments/owners. Remote re-sweep transport remains in the separate existing remote-work model; no composition proof is claimed.

gambitComparison.scope: Exact current comparison source, not a qualifying binary or proof of its GC behavior.
